_comment: Copy this file per tender (e.g. eligibility_rules_TENDER123.json), fill in the estimated_cost and thresholds from that tender's document, and the rule engine will compute PASS/FAIL automatically. No code changes needed.

criteria.label: Past Experience of Similar Services
criteria.note: PASS if ANY option is satisfied by qualifying experience certificates (each certificate individually must meet the per-contract value threshold implied by the option, or check total business rule - configure 'aggregation' below).

criteria.label: Average Annual Turnover (last 3 financial years)
criteria.note: Set either min_value_inr directly, or min_value_pct_of_estimate to compute from estimated_cost_inr.

criteria.label: CA Membership Number present on Turnover Certificate
